title: A/C Refrigerant Pressure Sensor A Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: a/c refrigerant pressure sensor a circuit.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates a/c refrigerant pressure sensor a circuit. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Vehicle is generally safe to drive short distances, but performance and emissions are affected.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect A/C pressure sensor wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect A/C pressure sensor part and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.

This DTC indicates hybrid battery cooling fan 2 control circuit. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Vehicle is generally safe to drive short distances, but performance and emissions are affected.

causes.cause: Faulty hybrid battery cooling fan component

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect hybrid battery cooling fan wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect hybrid battery cooling fan part and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.
